run_inference_cli: run the inference CLI with model path, dataset, and output directory arguments
load_model_magiclens: load a trained MagicLens model from a pickle file with specified size and path
build_fiq_dataset: build a FIQ dataset with tokenizer for fashion image-text retrieval evaluation
build_circo_dataset: build a CIRCO dataset with tokenizer for creative image retrieval evaluation
build_dtin_dataset: build a DTIN dataset with tokenizer for domain-specific image retrieval evaluation
run_inference_index: run index embedding inference on dataset images and text tokens in batches
run_inference_queries: run query embedding inference and compute top-50 similarity scores against index embeddings
evaluate_recall: evaluate retrieval recall on query examples with retrieved item IDs and scores
